name: Loometo
description: Node-based AI studio. Wire every major model into one canvas: image, video, audio, 3D.

data.label: Character Board
data.prompt:
Multi-panel character reference sheet for video identity lock. SUBJECT from reference photo: young woman early twenties, fair light skin with natural warmth, shoulder-length wavy blonde hair with a soft side part and loose curls framing the face, light blue-grey eyes, soft natural eyebrows, subtle everyday makeup with soft pink lips, friendly relaxed expression. Wardrobe: light blue chambray shirt worn open over a white top, small dark pendant necklace.

SHEET LAYOUT 1:1 at 1K, structured grid:
- 9 MACRO DETAIL PANELS (tight crops): (1) eye area showing light blue-grey iris and lash detail, (2) nose and cheek showing pores and light freckles, (3) lips in a half-open talking shape with soft pink tone, (4) jaw and chin, (5) hairline with wavy blonde curls and side part, (6) ear and earlobe, (7) hand and fingers in a relaxed gesturing pose, (8) pendant necklace close-up, (9) collarbone with chambray shirt collar and white top neckline.
- 8 HEAD AND SHOULDERS EXPRESSIONS: neutral, warm half smile, talking mid-syllable, laughing, impressed eyebrows-up, nodding approval, looking down at hands, looking direct to camera.
- 4 UPPER BODY ANGLES: front, three-quarter left, three-quarter right, profile.
- 8 SWATCHES along bottom: fair skin tone band, blonde hair band, chambray blue fabric, white top fabric, light blue-grey iris, soft pink lip, pendant metal, natural blush.

ANTI-FAKE SKIN baked through every panel: visible pores, peach fuzz, light freckles preserved, natural sebum sheen NOT glossy, subtle under-eye texture, micro-wrinkles at eye corners when smiling, baby hairs at temples.

IDENTITY LOCK: face geometry from reference photo with ZERO morphing between panels. Same person every panel. Blonde hair color and wave identical. Eye color identical. Skin tone identical. Build identical.

Lighting: clean even daylight studio reference. Background: clean off-white sheet, faint grid lines between panel groups. Sharp 1K, no compression, no AI smoothing.
data.negativePrompt: smoothed plastic AI skin, beauty filter, glossy sheen, porcelain doll, face morphing between panels, different person across panels, hair color drift, dark hair, brown eyes, eye color drift, freckles removed, heavy makeup, oversaturated, instagram filter, anime, illustration, cartoon, watermark, text overlay, two different women on the same sheet

data.label: Location Board
data.prompt: warm cozy creator and gaming desk setup as seen in the reference: ultrawide curved monitor on a wood riser, mechanical keyboard, two studio monitor speakers, wood slat accent wall, hanging plant, ambient warm orange and soft RGB glow, dark room. no people. keep it faithful to the reference.
data.negativePrompt: bright daylight, office fluorescent, people, clutter changes, different room layout, cartoon, illustration, watermark, text overlay

data.label: Product Board
data.prompt:
Multi-panel PRODUCT reference sheet for the Sony PS5 DualSense wireless controller, LeBron James Limited Edition. FAITHFUL to the reference: matte black shell, colourful hand-drawn graffiti art all over the body — multicolour crowns (yellow, blue, pink, white), small doodles, and handwritten text. On the touchpad centre the text reads 'NOTHING IS GIVEN.' in pink then 'EVERYTHING IS EARNED.' in white with a blue underline swoosh. On the right grip handwritten words 'CHOSEN ONES', 'BUILD UPLIFT EMPOWER', 'I PROMISE'. Standard PS5 face buttons (triangle circle cross square), dual analog sticks, D-pad, PS logo centre.

SHEET LAYOUT 1:1 at 1K:
- HERO front-on shot of the whole controller centred.
- 4 ANGLE panels: top-down, three-quarter left, three-quarter right, back with triggers.
- 6 MACRO panels: (1) touchpad text 'NOTHING IS GIVEN EVERYTHING IS EARNED' legible, (2) graffiti crowns cluster on left grip, (3) right-grip handwritten words legible, (4) analog stick texture, (5) face buttons, (6) trigger and bumper detail.
- colour swatch strip: matte black, crown yellow, crown blue, crown pink, white text, blue swoosh.

TEXT RENDERING is priority — every word on the controller must be spelled correctly and legible. Product on clean white studio background, soft even product lighting, crisp focus, no compression artifacts.
data.negativePrompt: misspelled text, garbled letters, extra buttons, wrong button symbols, glossy plastic when it should be matte, colour crowns missing, generic plain controller, Xbox controller, warped shape, reflections hiding the graffiti, watermark, cartoon, illustration
